description: This file contains utility functions for hashing and time formatting, including a custom hash function, a binary hash function, and a function to generate human-readable 'time ago' strings.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 based hash of a string using PBKDF2 with a salt.

methods.name: b_hash
methods.description: Generates a binary hash of a string using SHA-256 with PBKDF2 and a salt.

methods.name: ago
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representing how long ago a given datetime was.
